datasets.name: ds_inflation_freshness
queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(signal_date) AS day FROM monitor_daily_signal WHERE monitor_code = 'inflation_deflation' AND signal_code = 'rating' AND signal_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')) SELECT (SELECT day FROM asof) AS rating_date, (SELECT max(price_date) FROM silver_domain_investments.price_indicator_daily WHERE trading_symbol_code = '^TRCCRB') AS crb_price_date, (SELECT max(price_date) FROM silver_domain_investments.price_indicator_daily WHERE trading_symbol_code = 'GC=F') AS gold_price_date, (SELECT max(observation_date) FROM silver_domain_investments.market_rate_daily WHERE rate_code = 'us_federal_funds_effective_rate') AS rate_date, (SELECT max(observation_date) FROM silver_domain_investments.market_rate_daily WHERE rate_code = 'us_cpi_all_items_not_seasonally_adjusted' AND NOT is_carried_forward) AS cpi_reading_date

datasets.name: ds_rating
queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(signal_date) AS day FROM monitor_daily_signal WHERE monitor_code = 'inflation_deflation' AND signal_code = 'rating' AND signal_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')) SELECT s.signal_date AS rating_date, s.yes_count AS stars_on, CAST(s.measured_value AS INT) AS rating, s.action_name AS label, s.band_code AS rating_band, s.threshold_value AS cpi_change_twelve_months, s.reason_text FROM monitor_daily_signal s JOIN asof a ON s.signal_date = a.day WHERE s.monitor_code = 'inflation_deflation' AND s.signal_code = 'rating'

datasets.name: ds_stars
queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(signal_date) AS day FROM monitor_daily_signal WHERE monitor_code = 'inflation_deflation' AND signal_code = 'rating' AND signal_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')) SELECT s.signal_name, s.signal_code, CASE s.signal_code WHEN 'commodity_prices' THEN 1 WHEN 'consumer_prices' THEN 2 WHEN 'gold_prices' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS star_order, CASE WHEN s.is_yes THEN 'On' ELSE 'Off' END AS star_state, s.band_code AS star_band, s.measured_value, s.threshold_value, s.reason_text FROM monitor_daily_signal s JOIN asof a ON s.signal_date = a.day WHERE s.monitor_code = 'inflation_deflation' AND s.signal_code <> 'rating' ORDER BY star_order

datasets.name: ds_rating_history
queryLines: SELECT signal_date, yes_count AS stars_on, CAST(measured_value AS INT) AS rating, action_name AS label FROM monitor_daily_signal WHERE monitor_code = 'inflation_deflation' AND signal_code = 'rating' AND signal_date >= add_months(date_trunc('MONTH', current_date()), -35) ORDER BY signal_date

datasets.name: ds_crb_history
queryLines: SELECT price_date, price_close_adjusted AS price_close, close_adjusted_two_hundred_day_average_amount AS average_200 FROM silver_domain_investments.price_indicator_daily WHERE trading_symbol_code = '^TRCCRB' AND price_date >= add_months(date_trunc('MONTH', current_date()), -35) ORDER BY price_date

datasets.name: ds_gold_history
queryLines: SELECT price_date, price_close_adjusted AS price_close, close_adjusted_two_hundred_day_average_amount AS average_200 FROM silver_domain_investments.price_indicator_daily WHERE trading_symbol_code = 'GC=F' AND price_date >= add_months(date_trunc('MONTH', current_date()), -35) ORDER BY price_date

datasets.name: ds_cpi_history
queryLines: SELECT indicator_date, rate_value, two_hundred_day_average_value AS average_200 FROM silver_domain_investments.market_rate_indicator_daily WHERE rate_code = 'us_cpi_all_items_not_seasonally_adjusted' AND indicator_date >= add_months(date_trunc('MONTH', current_date()), -35) ORDER BY indicator_date

datasets.name: ds_rate_history
queryLines: SELECT indicator_date, rate_value, two_hundred_day_average_value AS average_200 FROM silver_domain_investments.market_rate_indicator_daily WHERE rate_code = 'us_federal_funds_effective_rate' AND indicator_date >= add_months(date_trunc('MONTH', current_date()), -35) ORDER BY indicator_date

datasets.name: ds_real_rate_history
queryLines: SELECT indicator_date, rate_value, two_hundred_day_average_value AS average_200 FROM silver_domain_investments.market_rate_indicator_daily WHERE rate_code = 'us_real_federal_funds_rate' AND indicator_date >= add_months(date_trunc('MONTH', current_date()), -35) ORDER BY indicator_date

datasets.name: ds_cpi_changes
queryLines: SELECT indicator_date, rate_value AS cpi_change, CASE rate_code WHEN 'us_cpi_change_twelve_months_percent' THEN 'Over 12 months' ELSE 'Against the previous reading' END AS change_label FROM silver_domain_investments.market_rate_indicator_daily WHERE rate_code IN ('us_cpi_change_twelve_months_percent', 'us_cpi_change_previous_reading_percent') AND indicator_date >= add_months(date_trunc('MONTH', current_date()), -35) ORDER BY indicator_date

datasets.name: ds_commodities
queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(signal_date) AS day FROM monitor_daily_signal WHERE monitor_code = 'inflation_deflation' AND signal_code = 'rating' AND signal_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')), names AS (SELECT * FROM VALUES ('^TRCCRB', 'CRB commodity index (votes)', 1), ('^SPGSCI', 'S&P GSCI commodity index', 2), ('GC=F', 'Gold futures (votes as gold)', 3), ('SI=F', 'Silver futures', 4), ('HG=F', 'Copper futures', 5), ('CL=F', 'WTI crude oil futures', 6), ('DBC', 'Invesco DB Commodity fund', 7), ('GSG', 'iShares S&P GSCI fund', 8) AS names(symbol, benchmark_name, benchmark_order)) , latest AS (SELECT p.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY p.trading_symbol_code ORDER BY p.price_date DESC) AS pick FROM silver_domain_investments.price_indicator_daily p JOIN asof a ON p.price_date <= a.day AND p.price_date >= date_sub(a.day, 7) WHERE p.trading_symbol_code IN (SELECT symbol FROM names)) SELECT n.benchmark_name, n.symbol, l.price_date, l.price_close_adjusted AS price_close, l.close_adjusted_two_hundred_day_average_amount AS average_200, l.price_close_adjusted / l.close_adjusted_two_hundred_day_average_amount - 1 AS distance_ratio, l.close_adjusted_two_hundred_day_average_slope_ratio AS slope_ratio, CASE WHEN l.price_close_adjusted > l.close_adjusted_two_hundred_day_average_amount THEN 'Above' ELSE 'Below' END AS position_text, CASE WHEN l.close_adjusted_two_hundred_day_average_slope_ratio > 0 THEN 'Rising' ELSE 'Falling' END AS direction_text, n.symbol = '^TRCCRB' AS is_vote FROM names n LEFT JOIN latest l ON l.trading_symbol_code = n.symbol AND l.pick = 1 ORDER BY n.benchmark_order

datasets.name: ds_commodities_history
queryLines: WITH names AS (SELECT * FROM VALUES ('^TRCCRB', 'CRB commodity index (votes)', 1), ('^SPGSCI', 'S&P GSCI commodity index', 2), ('GC=F', 'Gold futures (votes as gold)', 3), ('SI=F', 'Silver futures', 4), ('HG=F', 'Copper futures', 5), ('CL=F', 'WTI crude oil futures', 6), ('DBC', 'Invesco DB Commodity fund', 7), ('GSG', 'iShares S&P GSCI fund', 8) AS names(symbol, benchmark_name, benchmark_order)) SELECT p.price_date, n.benchmark_name, p.price_close_adjusted / p.close_adjusted_two_hundred_day_average_amount - 1 AS distance_ratio FROM silver_domain_investments.price_indicator_daily p JOIN names n ON n.symbol = p.trading_symbol_code WHERE p.close_adjusted_two_hundred_day_average_amount IS NOT NULL AND p.price_date >= add_months(date_trunc('MONTH', current_date()), -35) ORDER BY p.price_date

lines:
# Inflation-Deflation Monitor

Four vehicles each switch on a star when they point to inflation. The rating is the stars on.

- Commodity prices: the CRB index 200-day average is rising
- Consumer prices: the 200-day average of US consumer prices is rising
- Gold prices: gold is above its 200-day average
- Interest rates: the short-term rate (federal funds effective) is above its 200-day average

4 stars Increasing Inflation, 3 Inflation Danger, 2 Some Inflation Risk, 1 Mild or Decreasing Inflation, 0 Decreasing Inflation. Minus one is Deflation: no star on and consumer prices below their level of a year ago.

Change the date at the top. Consumer prices count from the first day of their month, before they are published.
